parsed_entries.requirement: The Significant Data Fiduciary must appoint an independent data auditor to conduct data audits and evaluate compliance with the Act.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document specifies the appointment of an independent data auditor for compliance evaluation.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applies to Significant Data Fiduciaries under the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is directly tied to the requirement for data audit and compliance evaluation.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Data Fiduciary must provide a summary of personal data being processed and the processing activities undertaken.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the document includes a summary of personal data processed and the associated processing activities.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement is part of the data principal's right to access their personal data.

parsed_entries.requirement: The Data Fiduciary must disclose the identities of all other Data Fiduciaries and Data Processors with whom personal data has been shared, along with a description of the data shared.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the document lists all Data Fiduciaries and Data Processors with whom personal data has been shared, along with a description of the data shared.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applies to Data Fiduciaries subject to the DPDP Act 2023.
parsed_entries.notes: This requirement is part of the data principal's right to know who has access to their personal data.
